args.name: path
args.doc: A path on www.agroplanet.cl: /, /nuestras-tiendas, /politica-despacho, /categoria/<slug>/<code>, /marca/<brand>, /producto/<slug>/<sku>.

moves.say: {page: /path} at the start of the sentence that takes them there.
moves.doc: Open a page of the store, inside the app (no reload).

args.name: target
args.doc: A heading, section or card title exactly as the page writes it.

args.name: path
args.doc: The page it is on, when it is not the one in front; it is opened first.

moves.say: {show: Heading} as you start talking about a part of the page.
moves.doc: Scroll to a heading, section or card on the page in front and ring it.

args.name: question
args.doc: The panel's title as the page writes it.

moves.say: {faq: Question} as you answer from one of the page's panels.
moves.doc: Open one panel of a policy page's accordion (Cambios y devoluciones, Despacho, Garantía) and ring its answer.

args.name: category
args.doc: A top category as the menu writes it: Baterías, Rodamientos, Lubricantes Y Fluidos, Repuestos De Tractor…

moves.say: {menu: Category} as you walk them through what a top category holds.
moves.doc: Open Todas las categorías and hover the category, so its flyout of subcategories shows, and ring it. Closes by itself on the next move.

moves.say: {tab: specs} as you talk about the product's specifications; details (Detalle del Producto), photos or price likewise.
moves.doc: On the product page in front, scroll to Detalle del Producto or Especificaciones, step through the gallery, or ring the price and its buttons.

args.name: category_path
args.doc: /categoria/<slug>/<code> from the category list, or /busqueda/<words> for a search.

args.name: filters
args.doc: Each "Facet: Option" exactly as the listing writes them ("Marca: LUBRITEK", "Viscosidad: 15W40", "Precio: $10.000 - $49.999"); several options of one facet as separate entries.

moves.doc: Go to the listing at category_path (in the app, if it is not the one in front), then tick each filter with the listing's own checkbox, one at a time, waiting for the grid; then the sort. Reports listing.shown and listing.filtered.

args.name: path
args.doc: /producto/<slug>/<sku>.

moves.doc: Open the product at path (in the app), then the section named. Reports product.shown, then product.checked from the store's live read.

args.name: query
args.doc: Words to search the catalogue for, in Spanish: "batería 12v 100ah", "cuchilla rotofresa".

args.name: category_code
args.doc: A category code from the category list (AG100, 1000902).

moves.doc: Read the store's own catalogue search in the visitor's browser, without moving the page: up to eight products with their live prices and stock, and how many match. Reports products_found.

args.name: paths
args.doc: Up to six /producto/<slug>/<sku> paths.

moves.doc: Read the live price, discount and stock of these products in the visitor's browser. Moves nothing. Reports prices_read.

args.name: path
args.doc: /producto/<slug>/<sku>.

args.name: store
args.doc: A store's name as /nuestras-tiendas writes it, or a city.

moves.doc: Read the product's stock online and in the stores that report it, in the visitor's browser. Moves nothing. Reports stock_read.

args.name: name
args.doc: A store's name or city as /nuestras-tiendas writes it.

moves.say: {store: Name} as you talk about one of the stores.
moves.doc: On /nuestras-tiendas (opened first if needed), find the store's card, scroll to it and ring it. Reports store_shown.
From the cart (/carro, opened first) press Cotizar and stop on the Formulario de cotización (/cotizacion). Agroplanet sells by quote: there is no online payment. Reports quote.changed.

args.name: name
args.doc: Nombre Completo / Razón Social.

args.name: phone
args.doc: Teléfono, digits as they said them.

args.name: region
args.doc: A Chilean región as the form lists it (Metropolitana, Maule…).

args.name: commune
args.doc: A comuna of that región.

args.name: unit
args.doc: Dpto / casa / Oficina.

args.name: notes
args.doc: Notas sobre tu cotización.

moves.doc: On the Formulario de cotización (/cotizacion), type each field given, once the visitor said yes. Never the RUT, never Crear cotización: those are the visitor's. Reports quote.changed.

slices.doc: the product page in front: its name, price, stock and specifications

fields.name: price
fields.doc: The price the page shows, CLP.

fields.name: regular_price
fields.doc: The struck price when there is a discount, CLP.

fields.name: price_hidden
fields.doc: The page says Confirmar precio en tienda instead of a price.

fields.name: source
fields.doc: page: read from the page; api: the store's live read.

slices.doc: the Formulario de cotización: which fields are filled and which are still missing (names only, never the values)

fields.name: filled
fields.doc: Field names: name, rut, phone, email, region, commune, street, number, unit, notes.

fields.name: items
fields.doc: Products in the Resumen del Pedido.

fields.name: total
fields.doc: The Total the summary shows, CLP.

events.doc: A product page came up, read from the page.
The store's live read of the product in front: its price and stock now.
The quote form on load and after a change; the brain writes its own line.
